content: 1. Drobac PC, Mukherjee JS, Joseph JK, Mitnick C, Furin JJ, del Castillo H, et al. conducted a study on community-based therapy for children diagnosed with multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB). This research was published in Pediatrics in 2006, volume 117, issue 6, pages 2022–2029. 2. Fairlie L, Beylis NC, Reubenson G, Moore DP, and Madhi SA reported a high prevalence of childhood multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in Johannesburg, South Africa. Their findings were based on a cross-sectional study and published in BMC Infectious Diseases in 2011, volume 11, article 28. 3. Gegia M, Jenkins HE, Kalandadze I, and Furin J analyzed the outcomes of children treated for tuberculosis using second-line medications in Georgia between 2009 and 2011. Their study appeared in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2013, volume 17, issue 5, pages 624–629. 4. Banerjee R, Allen J, Westenhouse J, Oh P, Elms W, Desmond E, et al. examined extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis (XDR-TB) cases in California from 1993 to 2006. Their research was published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2008, volume 47, issue 4, pages 450–457. 5. Hicks RM, Padayatchi N, Shah NS, Wolf A, Werner L, Sunkari VB, et al. identified malnutrition as a factor associated with unfavorable outcomes and mortality among South African children co-infected with MDR-TB and HIV. This study was published in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2014, volume 18, issue 9, pages 1074–1083. 6. Isaakidis P, Paryani R, Khan S, Mansoor H, Manglani M, Valiyakath A, et al. reported poor outcomes in a cohort of HIV-infected adolescents undergoing treatment for MDR-TB in Mumbai, India. Their findings were published in PLoS One in 2013, volume 8, issue 7, article e68869. 7. Datta BS, Hassan G, Kadri SM, Qureshi W, Kamili MA, Singh H, et al. investigated the prevalence of multidrug-resistant and extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis in Kashmir, India. Their study was published in the Journal of Infection in Developing Countries in 2009, volume 4, issue 1, pages 19–23. 8. Méndez Echevarría A, Baquero Artigao F, García Miguel MJ, Rojo Conejo P, Ballesteros Díez Y, Rubio Gribble B, et al. explored multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in the pediatric age group. Their findings were published in Anales de Pediatría (Barc) in 2007, volume 67, issue 3, pages 206–211. 9. Moore BK, Anyalechi E, van der Walt M, Smith S, Erasmus L, Lancaster J, et al. studied the epidemiology of drug-resistant tuberculosis among children and adolescents in South Africa from 2005 to 2010. Their research appeared in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2015, volume 19, issue 6, pages 663–669. 10. Kuksa L, Riekstina V, Leimane V, Ozere I, Skenders G, Van den Bergh R, et al. analyzed trends, characteristics, and treatment outcomes of multidrug-resistant and extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis in Latvia. Their study was published in Public Health Action in 2014, volume 4, supplement 2, pages S47–S53. 11. Santiago B, Baquero-Artigao F, Mejías A, Blázquez D, Jiménez MS, Mellado-Peña MJ, and the EREMITA Study Group investigated pediatric drug-resistant tuberculosis in Madrid, emphasizing the role of family dynamics. Their findings were published in the Pediatric Infectious Disease Journal in 2014, volume 33, issue 4, pages 345–350. 12. Seddon JA, Hesseling AC, Willemse M, Donald PR, and Schaaf HS described the clinical features, treatment, and outcomes of culture-confirmed MDR-TB in children. Their study was published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2012, volume 54, issue 2, pages 157–166. 13. Seddon JA, Hesseling AC, Godfrey-Faussett P, and Schaaf HS reported high treatment success rates in children treated for MDR-TB in an observational cohort study. Their research was published in Thorax in 2014, volume 69, issue 5, pages 458–464. 14. Kim DH, Kim HJ, Park SK, Kong SJ, Kim YS, Kim TH, et al. evaluated treatment outcomes and long-term survival in patients with extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis. Their findings were published in the American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine in 2008, volume 178, issue 10, pages 1075–1082. 15. Geerlings WA, Van Altena R, De Lange WCM, Van Soolingen D, and Van Der Werf TS studied long-term treatment outcomes of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in the Netherlands. Their research appeared in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2000, volume 4, issue 8, pages 758–764. 16. Williams B, Ramroop S, Shah P, Anderson L, Das S, Riddell A, et al. examined the presentation, management, and outcomes of MDR-TB in children in the UK. Their study was published in the European Respiratory Journal in 2013, volume 41, issue 6, pages 1456–1458. 17. Kim HR, Hwang SS, Kim HJ, Lee SM, Yoo CG, Kim YW, et al. assessed the impact of extensive drug resistance on treatment outcomes in non-HIV-infected patients with MDR-TB. Their findings were published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2007, volume 45, issue 10, pages 1290–1295.
